Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP to match the documented
and tested behavior.

args.head: fix-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `round_money` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the test and docstring require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).

This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.665` rounds to `2.66` and `2.675` rounds to `2.68`.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
